directory.conclusion: Device reports valid directory ObjectInfo but rejects child handle enumeration and child filename property-list requests with InvalidObjectHandle. AFT inserts directory cache before query; subsequent calls return cached empty directory after first failure. ADB shell also receives Permission denied; exact phone MTP internal mapping not proven.

timestamps.source_behavior: SetAttr handles SIZE only and acknowledges other attrs. ConvertDateTime(str) uses strptime without timezone then mktime.
timestamps.matching_process_TZ: CST-8 parses the same string to phone stat epoch; not yet verified through another FUSE mount and not a universal fix for arbitrary device timezone or suffixed timestamps.

lifecycle: Read-only FUSE and protocol VMs exited; protocol probe explicitly closed MTP session; no host NFS mount created.
decision: Keep AFT+standard sync as a candidate. These compatibility limits cannot all be fixed by NFS timing parameters. Frozen upstream driver policy remains; no patch applied.
